video_title: Head Coach Brian Keefe Media Availability | 10.8.26

quotes.speaker: Brian Keefe
quotes.summary_phrase: Alex Sarr's defensive impact and offensive efficiency in debut
quotes.excerpt: I thought he was terrific anchoring our defense, his communication, his ability to zone up
quotes.quote: I thought he was terrific anchoring our defense, his communication, his ability to zone up on the backside and then you saw his efficiency on the offensive end. He has been working hard on his game, extending the range. You saw that tonight and then he is going to settle us down when we play through the post. He is so comfortable down there. I thought he had a terrific showing for the first night.
quotes.social_post: Brian Keefe was impressed by Alex Sarr in his debut, highlighting his defensive anchoring and offensive efficiency. Keefe noted Sarr has been working hard on extending his range and playing through the post.

quotes.speaker: Brian Keefe
quotes.summary_phrase: Alex Sarr's defensive effort and transition scoring ability
quotes.excerpt: The biggest thing I thought with him is he had four steals, his effort on the defensive end
quotes.quote: The biggest thing I thought with him is he had four steals, his effort on the defensive end, cutting people off, playing in the passing lanes and then you saw him getting out in transition, getting easy baskets. Pretty good first showing.
quotes.social_post: Alex Sarr made an immediate impact in his first showing with four steals and active play in the passing lanes. Brian Keefe praised his effort on the defensive end and his ability to get easy baskets in transition.

quotes.speaker: Brian Keefe
quotes.summary_phrase: Alex Sarr's physical presence and defensive versatility
quotes.excerpt: You could feel his presence on the court, his ability to get into bodies
quotes.quote: You could feel his presence on the court, his ability to get into bodies, his ability to guard one-on-one and then he is just using his hands. He was active, he was in the right spots and when you are in the right spots, you can do a lot of good things. So for the first game for him, pretty good defensively effort. Nice job.
quotes.social_post: Brian Keefe praised Alex Sarr for his defensive versatility and physical presence in his debut, noting that Sarr was active, in the right spots, and effective at guarding one-on-one.

quotes.speaker: Brian Keefe
quotes.summary_phrase: DeAndre Ayton's rebounding and defensive impact
quotes.excerpt: They controlled the game defensively, you saw the rebounding by DeAndre, I think he had nine
quotes.quote: They controlled the game defensively, you saw the rebounding by DeAndre, I think he had nine in the first half, maybe 11, nine defensive boards. They just wanted to establish a defensive presence. We are going to see some different lineups throughout the preseason, try different combinations to see what fits, but we wanted to establish our size, our physicality.
quotes.social_post: Brian Keefe says the Wizards are experimenting with different lineups and combinations this preseason to establish their size and physicality, noting the impact of DeAndre Ayton on the boards.

quotes.speaker: Brian Keefe
quotes.summary_phrase: Team's depth at point guard and ball-handling rotation
quotes.excerpt: We got multiple handlers on our team, you can see that with Keyonte, AJ
quotes.quote: We got multiple handlers on our team, you can see that with Keyonte, AJ and then with guys we come off the bench here with Will Riley and Bub. So we have a lot of guys that can make decisions. We think that is going to be the best way forward for us to reach where we want to go to. I thought he did a draft job, he is just so unselfish, kicking the ball ahead, looking for his teammates, that stuff just brings energy to your team.
quotes.social_post: Brian Keefe is leaning into a rotation with multiple ball handlers, including Keyonte, AJ, Will Riley, and Bub. He believes this unselfish, decision-making approach is the best way forward for the team.

quotes.speaker: Brian Keefe
quotes.summary_phrase: Bub Carrington's scoring versatility and offensive impact
quotes.excerpt: Bub has an ability to make shots off the dribble and off the catch
quotes.quote: Bub has an ability to make shots off the dribble and off the catch. He has got a unique scoring ability from the three. I think he shot 40 off the dribble and off the catch last year. He gave us a little bit of a burst when our offense was getting a little stagnant, which can happen early preseason games. So we needed that little burst and Bub can give it to us.
quotes.social_post: Brian Keefe highlighted Bub Carrington's unique scoring ability, noting his capacity to hit shots off the dribble and catch. Carrington provided a much-needed burst for the Wizards when the offense became stagnant.

quotes.speaker: Brian Keefe
quotes.summary_phrase: Alex Sarr's physical development and offseason work
quotes.excerpt: It is definitely his physically has grown, tremendous amount of work, I think he has put on 10 to 12 pounds
quotes.quote: It is definitely his physically has grown, tremendous amount of work, I think he has put on 10 to 12 pounds muscle-wise. That just speaks to the work we talked about in my opening speech to the season was the investment each one of these guys made, and he was one of those guys. I talked about you are going to see physically these guys look different on the court, and he is one of those guys for sure.
quotes.social_post: Alex Sarr has added 10 to 12 pounds of muscle this offseason. Brian Keefe says the physical growth is a testament to the investment Sarr and the rest of the team have made in their development.
